title: A Controller reader could read a cluster's haproxy.cfg, VRRP/BGP and per-member secrets
description:
A cluster's versions and member list were served to any Controller account or API token with the reader role, unredacted. `GET /api/clusters/{id}/versions/{n}` returned every file of a version whole - `haproxy.cfg` (userlist and stats-auth passwords, credential headers), `keepalived.conf` (VRRP `auth_pass`) and `bird.conf` (BGP session passwords) - and the cluster view returned each member's `vars`, where an admin naturally puts a per-member password. On a node these are hidden from readers: `GetConfig` masks haproxy.cfg for a caller who may not apply a configuration (JANUS-2026-006), and `VRRPGetConfig`/`BGPGetConfig` are operator-only (JANUS-2026-005). The Controller gave all of it to readers.

**Affected**: a Controller with at least one cluster and an account or token holding the reader role.

**Fix**: a caller below operator now gets `haproxy.cfg` masked with the same redaction a node applies, no `keepalived.conf`/`bird.conf`, and no member `vars`; operators and admins see them unchanged.

**Besides updating**: nothing.
